name: a recorded lesson changes the plan the agent drafts
description: A reproduction prompt makes the reproduction index fire, the index hands over ids and titles only, and the model has to call lessons_search to get a body. The plan then has to carry the lesson's content. mentionsAllOf asserts two independent strings a model only writes if it read the body: conditions.tsv is a filename the lesson invents, and 'supplementary' is where the lesson says to look. Deliberately no mentionsNoneOf -- that scans the whole surface and would fail a compliant plan for quoting the advice back.
inputs: I'm reproducing the differential expression analysis from a published RNA-seq paper. The count matrix is already in hand. Draft a plan for getting from the deposited metadata to a DE result. Don't run anything yet.
Yes, that's right. Go ahead and draft the formal plan now.
